class.name: NNBlackboardKey
class.brief_description: A typed key definition for an [NNBlackboardSchema].
class.description: Defines a single key name, its expected [Variant] type, and an optional default value inside an [NNBlackboardSchema]. Add [NNBlackboardKey] entries to [member NNBlackboardSchema.keys] to catch typos or wrong value types written to a blackboard.

members.member: Value populated when [member has_default] is [code]true[/code] and the key is absent. Must match [member value_type].
If [code]true[/code], [member default_value] is installed when the schema is attached and the key is absent.
Name of the blackboard key. Must be non-empty and unique within the schema.
Required [Variant] type for non-[code]null[/code] values. [constant TYPE_NIL] accepts any type; [code]null[/code] is always allowed to clear a key.
